breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the periodic grid convention with Nx=1024 points on [0,1), dx=1/Nx, and x_j = j*dx for j=0,...,Nx-1. The conflicting 'dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)' interpretation from the incomplete prompt was properly discarded, matching the ground truth.
